wordingCorrection: Wall of Ice has flavor only. Exact printing reviewed, empty rules supplied explicitly; Oracle Defender remains separate. No broad empty-text inference from a missing provider field.
scope: All 302 original type labels have exact-printing reviews. Frozen native 0.6.6 inputs cover all 302. Outer stock-mask trials are verified on all 302; six-material internal geometry/color/black-level trials cover 277 nonland printings. No runtime calibration profile is adopted yet. Visual normalization certification, individual geometry regressions, land color and ten dual-land interiors, filled heading ink, mana, body/footer fitting and complete-set scoring remain open.

native.purpose: Baseline only; this is not a complete-set layout certification.

releaseBaseline.purpose: Native baseline, not a completed set calibration.

outerBoundaryDiagnostic.decision: The printed outer frame is consistently undersized, about two canonical pixels in width and height. Retain the independent scan poses. Trial frame/mask geometry and compare internal apertures before adjusting colors; do not hide renderer geometry errors with a new scan transform. Art/rules bevels and frame-family selection remain open.
outerBoundaryDiagnostic.proposal: Seven shared material transforms are predicted from the preselected calibration cohorts. Reserved-scan median residuals are 0.05-0.09 canonical px. These are boundary-model predictions, not replayed renderer scores. Native candidate and internal-aperture checks are required before adoption.

frameSourceReview.summary: ABU retained for six main materials after fitting every family to calibration-only art/paper boundaries. ABU has the best or nearly tied calibration mean; green is within 0.002 of Fourth. No alternate source has a decisive gain. Basic lands remain separately provisional; dual-overlay source/geometry is still open. Native source/geometry/color promotion is not implied by this diagnostic.

stockMaskTrial.scope: Existing source frame/art/lettering remain unchanged. All 302 independent poses are frozen. Default etching outputs match; this does not certify nondefault etching inputs.

jointGeometryTrial.scope: Regional frame-strip index only, not a whole-card Lab score. Two-axis frame transforms fit predeclared calibration cohorts only. All baseline faces match immutable native PNG bytes. Original scan poses remain fixed. Native inputs predate the new Dragon Whelp paragraph correction; these frame-only targets exclude its lettering.
jointGeometryTrial.remaining: The initial white regression was followed by seven shared candidates. A risk-aware calibration-only x+1px compromise improves both cohort means and reduces the largest regression to about seven regional points. Retain individual residuals. Illustration placement, all land interiors, contrast/black levels and typography still need verification; no per-card source offsets are adopted.

pigmentTrial.gap: All six ordinary 2ED frame materials currently resolve no HSB material correction even with set-hsb-v1 enabled. Existing source-specific guards remain enforced; do not alias an obsolete fit.
pigmentTrial.review: Native HSB materially improves five palettes; white keeps source pigment. Individual reference-palette outliers remain recorded, including dark Basalt Monolith and red Chaoslace. Contrast, interior black levels, mana, typography and 25 land interiors remain open. A selected main-material proposal is not a completed set.

selection.note: Exploratory shared compromise. It improves calibration and validation means while reducing the largest white regression from roughly 23 to 7 regional index points. It is not a per-scan fit or a new blind-validation result.

dualLandGeometry.remaining: Color, typography, symbols and full-card verification remain open. Art aperture underlap is verified, but art geometry is not scored by these frame strips.

basicLandColors.scope: Shared brown-frame adjustment across fifteen original basic references; five paper adjustments. The third illustration of every basic has a darker scan palette. Retain those five measured regressions; do not fit their color individually. Colored rim accents have a separate native-verified candidate. Contrast/black levels and reuse on the ten dual composites remain open. No independent-name validation or complete-set certification.

typographyProbes.scope: Original words, independent fixed scan poses, exact full native baseline hashes. Reference dimensions are explicitly canonicalized and checked; title crops exclude mana and type crops exclude the art border. Filled gray is fixed at 130 during geometry probes. Individual fits are diagnostic and are not runtime overrides. Shared header/credit profiles, ink tone, body text, mana and whole-set validation remain open.

typographyShared.scope: One heading, type and artist geometry candidate per set, selected on calibration names only. Validation names are reused development observations. Original wording, independent scan poses, canonical 488x680 references, exact current full-card PNG hashes and zero-command replay parity are checked for all fifty-five inputs. Gray 130 is a fixed geometry-measurement control; it is not an adopted ink color. No per-printing offsets are proposed. Native profile replay after frame/color integration, actual ink tone/shadows, body text, mana and full-set verification remain open.

bodyPolicy.scope: All 302 current original faces have actual native score and isolation checks. Dragon Whelp uses its reviewed inline quotation; the remaining 301 measurements and selected PNGs are reused only after exact provided face, asset/reference, painter and pose comparisons. The common candidate parameters are unchanged and all 302 cached native scores are independently recomputed. The medium-density guard uses original compiled size and line count. These are per-set options, never printing-specific offsets. Material integration and Oracle behavior still need checking.

powerToughness.review: The global position/size probe improves the regional mean but regresses 26 of 92 cases, up to 11.1 points. Zoom inspection shows stroke/ink contrast differences, including 1/x examples; resolve ink/stroke/shadow matching before accepting a universal positional refit. No per-card stats overrides are proposed.

defaultEtchingAudit.clarification: Earlier evidence descriptions called these default etching outputs. They actually contain the default set-mark fallback: 13,366 covered pixels in the unchanged plane. Historical hash-equality checks remain valid; they do not establish zero coverage. No illustration-etch resolver was used. Keep historical compressed evidence unchanged.

integrationRequirements.frame: Source-bound ordinary and five basic plates, shared dual composite, independent SVG stock-mask geometry; retain existing foreign-set behavior.
integrationRequirements.color: Basic colored rims have a native-verified shared candidate with all residuals retained. Finish land contrast/black levels and composed dual paper/pinline palettes before final text verification.
integrationRequirements.wording: Current Dragon Whelp original-body refresh is verified with all 302 native body results. Reuse this reviewed provided input; do not run an older wording resolver over it during final profile verification.
integrationRequirements.typography: Measure filled ink/stroke/shadow values separately from fixed-gray geometry; retain MPlantin credits unless new evidence supports another face.
integrationRequirements.body: Integrate shared count/wrap and medium-density retention with original/Oracle safety preserved; verify final full native inputs.
integrationRequirements.mana: Disc/glyph/numeral size, pitch/placement and paper/ink color remain open.
integrationRequirements.footer: Preserve printed Illus. © prefix and absence of a separate Unlimited legal line.
integrationRequirements.receipts: Scoped integration and source-equivalence evidence must preserve immutable historical receipts and avoid reopening unrelated sets.
integrationRequirements.completion: Full profile/whole-card validation and visual boundary certification are still required. No renderer profile is adopted by these study files.

basicLandAccents.scope: One source-local outline adjustment per basic color, shared across its three illustrations. Fixed projected line strips measure color; shared source rings and hue weights apply it during cached material preparation. Group means improve for all five colors, but black median error rises and four individual printings regress. Preserve every residual, including the 3.83-unit white regression. No per-card palette or per-scan offset/color fit; no independent-name validation. Land contrast/black levels and dual composite/pinline colors still need checks.
